# javis-os

Parts of VANHANH are adapted from this project. Its MIT license asks that the notice below travel with the code.

Source: https://github.com/blogminhquy/javis-os

Used for: the time zone setting, smoother streaming in chat, local reset times for plan limits, wide
tables in chat, keeping slow server work off the event loop, the stable Claude Code prompt, and the
Windows `npx` and `/C:/` link fixes (VANHANH 1.4.0).
